name: application-account-balance-card
title: Account Balance Card
description: Bank account card with a maskable balance (show/hide toggle), the account's last-four digits, and a row of quick actions (Send, Deposit, Transfer).
useWhen: Showing a bank or checking/savings account balance in a personal finance or banking dashboard.
The balance is sensitive and the user should be able to mask it (e.g. shoulder-surfing in public) via a show/hide toggle.
You want quick primary actions (Send, Deposit, Transfer) directly attached to the account they affect.
avoidWhen: You're showing a crypto/token balance, not a bank account — use `token-balance-row` for that unrelated context.
The balance never needs to be hidden — drop the show/hide toggle and just render the value.
There are more than three quick actions — use a menu or overflow rather than widening the grid.
responsiveBehavior: Single-column card at a fixed max width; the three-action grid stays in a fixed 3-column layout, icons and labels wrapping rather than columns collapsing.
accessibility: The show/hide button uses aria-label and aria-pressed reflecting the current masked state, not just an icon swap.
Masked balance renders as bullet characters rather than removing the element, so screen readers reading before a toggle interaction still get a stable structure.
Each quick action is a real <button> with a visible text label alongside its icon, not an icon-only control.
